title: eludite.browser.tab_close input
description: Close a browser tab (default: the active tab). The most recently selected remaining tab becomes active. The browser keeps running with no tabs; it is closed with the workspace. Fails when the tab does not exist.

tab.description: The tab: its id from eludite.browser.tabs (`t1`, `t2`, ...). Default: the active tab (the one last opened or selected).
